title: SoftBank's Son explored $1 trillion buyout of SK Hynix: The Information
summary: SoftBank and SK Hynix did not immediately respond to Reuters requests for comment on the report, which cited people familiar with the matter. The Information Son quoted a SoftBank spokesperson as saying the company was no longer considering such a deal.
llm_summary: SoftBank’s founder Masayoshi Son had reportedly looked into a possible $1 trillion acquisition of memory‑chip maker SK Hynix, according to the outlet The Information. Both SoftBank and SK Hynix declined to comment, and a SoftBank spokesperson later said the group is no longer pursuing the deal. This suggests the ambitious takeover talk has effectively been dropped.
